title: Agora mesmo
theme: O que está acontecendo neste momento — present continuous
goal: Aluno sai sabendo formar e usar present continuous (I'm doing, he's working), distinguir de present simple (rotina vs agora), e descrever cenas presentes.
connects_to: M10 (Comida e bebida) — depois de dominar continuous, aplica em situações como "I'm eating", "She's drinking".
module_chunks: I'm not working / He isn't studying
Are you working? / Is she sleeping?
What are you doing? / What is he doing?
right now / at the moment / today
contrast: I work in NYC (rotina) vs I'm working today (agora)

units.title: Estou fazendo agora
units.real_life_context: Você descreve o que está fazendo agora — durante uma chamada de vídeo, por exemplo.

grammar.explanation: Com "I" usa "am" no present continuous: "I am working" ou contraído "I'm working".
Com he/she/it usa "is": "She is sleeping" ou "She's sleeping".
Com they/we/you usa "are": "They are playing" ou "They're playing".
Present continuous: to be + verb-ing. "Read" → "reading" (apenas adiciona -ing).
"He is watching" — present continuous com he/she/it usa "is".
Verbos curtos terminados em consoante-vogal-consoante dobram a última consoante antes de -ing: run → running, sit → sitting, swim → swimming.
Verbos terminados em -e mudo perdem o e antes de -ing: make → making, write → writing, take → taking.
Present continuous = to be + verb-ING. "I am working", não "I am work".
Present continuous SEMPRE precisa de "to be" + verb-ing. "She is working" ou "She's working", nunca "She working".

units.title: Não estou fazendo
units.grammar_focus: Present continuous negativo (am not / isn't / aren't + verb-ing)
units.real_life_context: Você corrige uma suposição errada ou diz o que NÃO está acontecendo agora.

grammar.explanation: Negativa com "I": "I am not working" ou "I'm not working". Não usa don't (que é present simple).
"She isn't sleeping" — 3ª pessoa negativa = is + not = isn't. Forma contraída padrão.
"We aren't" — plural negativa = are + not = aren't.
"He isn't working" — 3ª pessoa singular negativa.
"I'm not studying" — "am not" contrai pra "'m not". Não existe "amn't" em inglês padrão.
"She isn't cooking" — is + not contrai pra "isn't".

grammar.sentence: They _____ watching TV; they're playing games.
grammar.explanation: "They aren't watching" — are + not = aren't.
Present continuous negativa = forma de "to be" + not + verb-ing. NÃO usa don't/doesn't (que é present simple). "She isn't working".
"Amn't" NÃO existe — apenas "I'm not". A contração de "am not" é só "'m not".

units.title: Está fazendo?
units.grammar_focus: Present continuous questions (Are you...? Is she...?)
units.real_life_context: Você liga pra alguém e pergunta o que essa pessoa está fazendo.

grammar.explanation: Pergunta de present continuous: inverte "to be". "Are you working?" — "you" usa "are".
"Is she sleeping?" — he/she/it usa "is" invertido na pergunta.
"Are they playing?" — they/we/you usam "are".
WH-question com you: "What are you doing?" — "are" após o WH.
"Is he watching?" — "he" usa "is" invertido.
"What is she doing?" — WH + is + sujeito + verb-ing.
"Yes, I am" — short answer com to be. Repete o auxiliar.
Continuous pergunta com "to be" invertido, não com "do/does". "Are you working?", não "Do you working?".
Após "Is + sujeito", verb-ing: "Is she working?". "Works" seria present simple (sem -ing).

grammar.passage: Q: Are you working today? A: No, I'm not. I'm reading. Q: Is your sister studying? A: Yes, she is. She's preparing for an exam.
grammar.question: What is the speaker doing?
grammar.explanation: The text says "I'm reading".

listening_speaking.text: Yes, I am. No, I'm not.

units.title: Hoje, agora, neste momento
units.grammar_focus: Time expressions for continuous (right now / at the moment / today / this week)
units.real_life_context: Você descreve atividades temporárias — desta semana, deste mês, neste momento.

grammar.explanation: "Right now" combina com continuous (ação atual). "Every day" e "on Mondays" combinam com present simple (rotina).
"This week" indica atividade temporária — combina com continuous. "Every week" é rotina (simple).
"Today" pode indicar temporário (não como sempre) — combina com continuous.
"At the moment" = agora mesmo. Sinaliza continuous.
"Right now" enfatiza a ação no momento. Continuous + right now é combinação natural.
"This week" — período presente e específico. Combina com continuous.
"This month" — atividade temporária em curso.

grammar.sentence: I'm working every day right now.
grammar.answer: I'm working a lot right now.
grammar.explanation: "Every day" + present continuous é contradição. Use "every day" com simple, ou "right now / today" com continuous. Aqui: troca pra "a lot right now".
"On Mondays" indica rotina — use present simple. Pra continuous, marcadores como "right now" ou "this week".

grammar.passage: I'm working from home this week. My sister is visiting from London. We're having dinner together every night.

units.title: Simple vs Continuous
units.grammar_focus: Contrast present simple vs present continuous
units.real_life_context: Você diferencia o que faz NORMALMENTE (rotina) do que está fazendo AGORA (temporário).

grammar.sentence: I _____ in São Paulo, but I _____ in NYC this month.
I _____ in São Paulo (it's my home).
grammar.explanation: Lugar onde mora habitualmente (rotina) usa present simple: "I live". Continuous seria temporário.

grammar.sentence: I _____ in NYC this month (temporary stay).
grammar.explanation: Estada temporária usa present continuous: "I am living in NYC this month". "Live" seria permanente.

grammar.sentence: She usually _____ coffee, but today she _____ tea.
grammar.explanation: "Usually" indica rotina → present simple: "She drinks coffee". (A segunda parte usaria "is drinking" — continuous pra hoje.)
"Right now" sinaliza continuous: "We are having dinner". Present simple seria rotina diária.

grammar.sentence: He _____ to the gym every day, but today he _____ at home.
grammar.hint: 1) Rotina; 2) Está atualmente. Coloque o primeiro.
grammar.explanation: "Every day" indica rotina = present simple. "He goes to the gym". (E o segundo seria "is staying").
Habilidade permanente usa present simple: "She speaks Italian". Não continuous.
"Look! It is raining" — ação que está acontecendo neste momento. Continuous.

grammar.sentence: I am working in a bank every day.
grammar.answer: I work in a bank every day.
grammar.explanation: "Every day" indica rotina — use present simple: "I work". Continuous + every day é contradição.

grammar.answer: She is drinking coffee right now.
grammar.explanation: "Right now" indica ação no momento — use continuous: "She is drinking". Present simple seria rotina.

grammar.passage: I usually wake up at seven, but today I'm waking up at nine — it's Sunday! My brother always cooks on Sundays. He's making pancakes right now.
grammar.question: What is the brother making right now?
grammar.explanation: The text says "He's making pancakes right now".

listening_speaking.text: She is speaking on the phone now.
They usually play soccer, but today they're playing tennis.

cross_unit_consolidation: Present continuous positivo: to be + verb-ing (I'm working, she's reading)
Present continuous negativo: am not / isn't / aren't + verb-ing
Present continuous questions: inversão de "to be" (Are you working? What is she doing?)
Marcadores temporais: right now / at the moment / today / this week (combinam com continuous)
Marcadores de rotina: every day / always / on Mondays (combinam com simple)
Contraste claro: "I usually X, but I'm Ying right now"
